summary: Frontend-only validation completed for the language toggle refinement on public preview and local serving modes. Visual, gesture, navigation, geometry, asset integrity, and regression suites all passed.
action_items: No functional fixes required in requested scope.
critical_code_review_comments: No toggle functional regression found: rail uses single full-coverage SVG background, stationary during drag, and switches only on commit.
Gesture logic correctly uses nearest-endpoint commit and no velocity override; short 8px drag now snaps back without navigation.
Maintainability note: /app/frontend/css/styles.css is 2693 lines (>700 guideline), consider modular split in future refactor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed targeted Playwright checks on preview URL: verified full-rail TR/GB backgrounds, overflow hidden, cover crop, stationary background during pointermove, glass/translucent knob styling, release-to-commit behavior, short-drag snapback, Escape cancel, keyboard navigation, back/forward state restore, and reduced-motion transition suppression. Ran pytest regressions: 6/6 lang_toggle_regression, 61/61 i18n_serving_modes, 98/98 static_pages all passing. Verified SVG SHA-256 hashes match documented values and markup updater is idempotent (0 pages changed on repeated runs).
rca of the issue: No defect reproduced in this iteration. Prior risk areas (velocity flick behavior, split-flag windows, and non-idempotent markup updates) were specifically rechecked and passed under real interaction tests.
